data.title: Announcing Our New Claude Code Skill
data.author: Eric Kong

content.text: We wanted a fast way to draft articles directly from Claude Code.
The skill uploads the featured image via the Asset API, then creates the document via the Migration API.
Drafts only — publishing is still manual.
Uses your existing article custom type.

data.meta_title: Announcing Our New Claude Code Skill
data.meta_description: We built a small Claude Code skill that drafts new articles into Prismic CMS.
